title: Dunjunz, the 1986 cassette
label: The game
notes: The four game files of Dunjunz_B.uef, an image of the Bug-Byte cassette from The Stairway to Hell archive, read with tools/read_uef.py: DUNK (&0400, 1023 bytes, entered at &0740; the figures above), Dunjunz4 (&08C0, 5952 bytes), Dunjunz5 (&2000, 4096 bytes) and Dunjunz3 (&6E80, 4480 bytes). TITLE's */ runs DUNK, whose loader at &0740 loads Dunjunz1; that loads the loading screen, Dunjunz3 and Dunjunz4 and jumps to &0D00, which loads Dunjunz5 and starts the game. The levels, LEVEL1-LEVEL25, follow on the tape, encrypted, and are read through FILEV as the game goes on. The game listing saves all four files. TITLE (the title page) and Dunjunz1 (the game loader) are disassembled on their own; DUNJUNZ and PLOAD, the BASIC machine check and intro, are shown as source.

disassemblies.label: TITLE: title page
disassemblies.runtime: TITLE, load &2800, exec &28CE, &C00 bytes. Run by PLOAD's */ after the intro: selects MODE 5, draws the picture it carries (a framed BUG BYTE logo and a face), prints the author, the copyright and a note to see the inlay card, then selects *TAPE and runs the next file on the tape, DUNK, with */.

disassemblies.label: Dunjunz1: the game loader
disassemblies.runtime: Dunjunz1, load &2000, exec &2000, &169 bytes. Loaded and entered by DUNK's loader at &0740: sets MODE 2 with 25 rows and every colour black, loads and shows the loading screen (Dunjunz2), loads Dunjunz3 and Dunjunz4, and jumps to &0D00 in the game.

source_files.label: DUNJUNZ: the machine check (BBC BASIC; line 0's control codes shown as Unicode control pictures)
PLOAD: the intro (BBC BASIC; line 0's control codes shown as Unicode control pictures)
